title: A Man for Every Month
description: To get a feature out for her company's Man for Every Month blog, an introverted writer has to go on a date with a different man every month.

title: The Love Club: Tara
description: Outspoken Tara has always professed she doesn't need a partner, but when she decides to plan a commitment-to-herself party, the Love Club and her perfect match show up just in time.

title: Dying For A Baby
description: A couple have their world turned upside down when the other driver in their car accident moves in next door.

title: The Wrong Nanny
description: A woman hires a seemingly perfect nanny to help with her twin baby boys, only to discover that the young woman is the daughter she gave up for adoption at birth.

title: Deadly Exchange
description: Blake becomes good friends with foreign exchange student Chloe, even moving in together. However, when Blake's boyfriend is killed, and she must prove her innocence, Blake begins to realise Chloe's real plan.

title: The Joneses: Unplugged
description: The newly married Rebecca and Matthew both can't imagine life without their smartphones and other electronic gadgets. One day, when there is a major power outage, the couple realise that they need to make more time for each other.

title: Deadly Vows
description: A pastry chef named Helena takes severe revenge on men who do not meet her high expectations by poisoning them. Her sister becomes suspicious that her sister is a culinary killer, and takes matters into her own hands to try to save Helena's fiancé.

title: Wish You Were Dead
description: After expressing her concerns about her dangerous ex-husband, a woman unintentionally ends up in a killing pact with two other people.

description:
